prd_clarifications: Should the "Read more" link toggle to "Show less" and collapse the text, or is expansion one‑way only?
When a post is deleted while the user is on the Posts tab, must the UI remove it in real‑time or only on next pagination request?
Is there a maximum number of topics per post that impacts the Posts tab UI (e.g., layout overflow)?
For rate‑limit handling, does the client need to implement exponential back‑off, or is a simple retry sufficient?
case_review.recommendation: The test suite provides solid coverage of the happy‑path pagination and UI rendering requirements, but it lacks depth in API contract validation, error‑recovery flows, and localisation. Address the critical gaps around muted/blocked filtering verification and rate‑limit retry logic, and add the missing test cases outlined above. Once these are incorporated, the coverage will be near‑complete and the suite will be robust for regression testing.

traceability_matrix.requirement_summary: Default Posts tab loads first page (10) sorted reverse‑chronologically
Post text truncation at 200 characters with tappable "Read more" (expand/collapse)
Infinite scroll pagination loads subsequent pages, respects pageSize=10, appends without duplication
End‑of‑feed indicator when no more posts are available
Posts from muted/blocked users are filtered out on all pages
Empty state messages for own profile and for other users
Network/API error handling – toast with retry, no duplicate posts
Session expiry handling during pagination – 401 leads to login redirect
Visibility icon reflects post visibility (Everyone, Followers Only, Mentioned, Anonymous)
Engagement stats (views, likes, comments) displayed correctly, null → 0 handling
Media preview thumbnails on post cards, lightbox opening, View Post link
Rate‑limit (429) handling – graceful toast, no crash

test_cases.name: Default Posts Tab loads first page sorted by recency
test_cases.precondition: User is authenticated and navigates to their Profile Page; no existing posts in cache

steps.action: Given the user opens the Profile Page
When the Posts tab is displayed
Then the first 10 posts are fetched from the Post API with page=1 and pageSize=10
And the posts are displayed in reverse chronological order (newest first)
And each post card shows truncated text (200 chars) with a "Read more" link if necessary

test_cases.expected_result: The UI shows a list of up to 10 posts sorted by recency, with correct truncation and "Read more" links where applicable

test_cases.name: Infinite scroll loads subsequent pages when user reaches bottom

test_cases.precondition: Profile contains at least one post with 250 characters of text

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post list renders
Then the post card shows only the first 200 characters followed by a "Read more" link
And tapping "Read more" expands the full text inline

test_cases.expected_result: Full post text is revealed without navigating away

test_cases.name: Media preview thumbnail renders correctly on post cards with images
test_cases.precondition: Profile has a post with 2 attached images

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post list renders
Then each image thumbnail is displayed in the card
And tapping a thumbnail opens the image in a lightbox

test_cases.expected_result: Lightbox shows the correct image and navigation controls

test_cases.name: Lazy loading fetches next 10 posts when user scrolls to bottom of list
test_cases.precondition: Profile has 25 posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the current list
Then the app requests the next 10 posts from the API
And the new posts are appended to the list

test_cases.expected_result: Total of 20 posts displayed after first scroll, 25 after second

test_cases.name: Empty state message displays when user has no posts
test_cases.precondition: Profile has zero posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the page loads
Then the UI shows the message "You haven’t posted yet."

test_cases.expected_result: No post cards are rendered

test_cases.name: Network error during initial post load shows retry toast
test_cases.precondition: Profile has posts but API is set to timeout

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the API request times out
Then an inline toast appears with message "Unable to load posts. Retry."
And a functional Retry button is present

test_cases.expected_result: Retry triggers a new API call

test_cases.name: Pagination stops after all posts are loaded
test_cases.precondition: Profile has 15 posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls to the bottom twice
Then the app does not request more posts
And a "No more posts" indicator is shown

test_cases.expected_result: No additional API calls are made after 15 posts

test_cases.name: Rapid scrolling triggers debounced pagination without duplicate posts
test_cases.precondition: Profile has 50 posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls rapidly to the bottom multiple times
Then the app queues a single pagination request per 500ms window
And the resulting list contains unique posts only

test_cases.expected_result: No duplicate posts appear in the list
weird_edge_cases: User scrolls faster than API response time

test_cases.name: Session expiry during pagination reverts to login screen
test_cases.precondition: User is authenticated but token expires during scroll

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the token expires while fetching next page
Then the app redirects to the login screen

test_cases.expected_result: No partial data is displayed; user must re-authenticate
weird_edge_cases: Token expires mid-request

test_cases.name: Post card shows correct visibility icon for public posts
test_cases.precondition: Profile has a public post

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post list renders
Then the visibility icon displayed is the public icon

test_cases.expected_result: Icon matches design spec for public visibility

test_cases.name: Post card displays "You (Anonymous)" label when user posts anonymously
test_cases.precondition: User has an anonymous post on their profile

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post list renders
Then the post card shows the label "You (Anonymous)"

test_cases.expected_result: Label is visible and correctly formatted

test_cases.name: Pagination request includes correct page token for subsequent loads
test_cases.precondition: Profile has 30 posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the first 10 posts load
And the user scrolls to bottom
Then the API request includes pageToken from the previous response

test_cases.expected_result: Server returns next 10 posts

test_cases.name: Post list scroll position is preserved after orientation change
test_cases.precondition: User has scrolled to 3rd page of posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the device orientation changes from portrait to landscape
Then the scroll position remains at the same post

test_cases.expected_result: No jump or reload occurs
weird_edge_cases: Orientation change mid-scroll

test_cases.name: Post list shows correct engagement stats for each post
test_cases.precondition: Profile has posts with known view counts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post list renders
Then each post card displays the correct view count next to the eye icon

test_cases.expected_result: Engagement numbers match backend data

test_cases.name: Pagination handles API rate limit exceeded gracefully
test_cases.precondition: API is configured to return 429 after 5 requests

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls to load 6th page
Then the app shows a toast "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."

test_cases.expected_result: No crash; user can retry after backoff

test_cases.name: Default Posts tab loads with newest posts and truncates long text
test_cases.precondition: User is authenticated and has at least 5 public posts with varying lengths, including one post >200 characters

steps.action: Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the "Posts" tab must be selected by default
And the system must query the Post API and return the 10 newest posts
And each post card displays the text truncated at 200 characters with a "Read more" link for the long post
And the "Read more" link expands the full text inline when tapped

test_cases.expected_result: The first 10 posts appear in reverse chronological order, long text is truncated with a functional "Read more" link that expands correctly

test_cases.name: Infinite scroll loads next set of posts after scrolling to bottom
test_cases.precondition: User has 25 posts; API supports pagination with pageSize=10

steps.action: Given the user is on the Profile Page with the Posts tab selected
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the list
Then the system must request the next 10 posts via the Post API
And the new posts are appended to the list maintaining reverse chronological order

test_cases.expected_result: 15 posts are visible after first scroll, 25 after second scroll, no duplicates, order preserved
edge_cases: exactly 10 posts total; no further load
weird_edge_cases: rapid scroll to bottom multiple times before API response

test_cases.name: Posts tab shows empty state when user has no posts
test_cases.precondition: User has zero posts in the system

steps.action: Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the "Posts" tab must display the empty state message "You haven’t posted yet."

test_cases.expected_result: Empty state message is visible and no post cards are rendered

test_cases.name: Pagination stops after last page and shows no more posts
test_cases.precondition: User has 12 posts; pageSize=10

steps.action: Given the user is on the Profile Page with the Posts tab selected
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the list
Then the system must request the next 10 posts
And only 2 posts are returned
And no further load indicator appears after scrolling past the last post

test_cases.expected_result: Total 12 posts displayed; scrolling beyond last post does not trigger additional API calls
edge_cases: last page with less than pageSize items

test_cases.name: Deleted posts are excluded from the Posts tab list
test_cases.precondition: User has 5 posts, 2 of which are marked as deleted in the backend

steps.action: Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the system must query the Post API and exclude any posts with status "deleted"
And only 3 posts are displayed in the list

test_cases.expected_result: Deleted posts are not rendered; list contains only non-deleted posts

test_cases.name: Visibility filter respects follower-only posts for non-followers
test_cases.precondition: User A has a follower-only post; User B does not follow User A

steps.action: Given User B navigates to User A’s Profile Page
When the Posts tab loads
Then the system must filter out any posts with visibility "Followers Only" that User B does not have access to

test_cases.expected_result: Only public or everyone posts are displayed; follower-only post is hidden

test_cases.name: Rapid scroll triggers multiple pagination requests but results are deduplicated
test_cases.precondition: User has 30 posts; API latency 1s

steps.action: Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user scrolls rapidly to the bottom multiple times before the first pagination response returns
Then the system must queue or coalesce pagination requests to avoid duplicate posts
And the final list contains 30 unique posts in correct order

test_cases.expected_result: No duplicate posts; pagination handled gracefully under rapid user interaction
weird_edge_cases: rapid scroll before API response

test_cases.name: Session expiry during pagination does not crash the list
test_cases.precondition: User is authenticated; session token expires after 5 minutes; user has 20 posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Profile Page and has scrolled to load the first 10 posts
When the session token expires while the user is scrolling to load the next page
Then the API call must return 401
And the UI must display an inline error toast "Session expired. Please log in again." with a Retry button that redirects to login

test_cases.expected_result: No crash; graceful error handling and redirection
weird_edge_cases: session expiry mid-pagination

test_cases.name: Posts tab respects maximum allowed posts per page when API returns more than requested
test_cases.precondition: API is misconfigured to return 50 posts per request despite pageSize=10

steps.action: Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the system requests the first page of posts
Then the UI must display only the first 10 posts from the response and ignore the rest

test_cases.expected_result: Only 10 posts are rendered; excess data is discarded
edge_cases: API returns more items than requested

test_cases.name: Read more link collapses expanded text when tapped again
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with 250 characters

steps.action: Given the user is on the Profile Page and the post is truncated with a "Read more" link
When the user taps the "Read more" link
Then the full text is displayed
And the link text changes to "Show less"
When the user taps "Show less"
Then the text truncates back to 200 characters

test_cases.expected_result: Toggle between expanded and collapsed states works correctly

test_cases.name: Display latest 10 posts in reverse chronological order with correct UI elements
test_cases.precondition: User is authenticated and has at least 15 posts (mix of public, followers-only, and anonymous) in their profile.

steps.action: Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the Posts tab loads
Then the system must query the Post API with parameters: page=1, limit=10, order=desc
And the first 10 posts are displayed in reverse chronological order
And each post card shows truncated text at 200 characters with a "Read more" link, media preview if present, topic tags, visibility icon, timestamp, and engagement stats

test_cases.expected_result: The UI renders the first 10 posts correctly, with all specified elements visible and functional, and the "Read more" link expands the full text inline.
combination_edge_cases: Combination of public, followers-only, and anonymous posts in same page
weird_edge_cases: Post text containing zero-width spaces that should not affect truncation

test_cases.name: Infinite scroll loads next set of posts after reaching bottom of first page
test_cases.precondition: User has 25 posts in total and is on the Posts tab with the first 10 loaded.

steps.action: Given the user scrolls to the bottom of the first 10 posts
When the infinite scroll trigger fires
Then the system must request the next page of posts (page=2, limit=10)
And the next 10 posts are appended to the list in correct order
And the loading indicator appears during the API call
And no duplicate posts are shown

test_cases.expected_result: After scrolling, posts 11-20 appear appended, loading indicator disappears, and the list continues to grow without duplication.
combination_edge_cases: Scrolling while a previous load is still pending
weird_edge_cases: User scrolls rapidly to bottom before first load completes

test_cases.name: Empty state displays correctly when user has no posts and anonymous posts are labeled appropriately
test_cases.precondition: User has zero posts in their profile.

steps.action: Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the Posts tab loads
Then the system must query the Post API and receive an empty list
And the UI displays the empty state message: "You haven’t posted yet."
And if the user is viewing another user’s profile with no posts, the message shows: "[User Name] hasn't posted yet."

test_cases.expected_result: The empty state message appears exactly as specified, with correct user name interpolation, and no post cards are rendered.
combination_edge_cases: Viewing another user's profile with no posts
weird_edge_cases: User name contains special characters that could break interpolation
